people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.
translations.bsb: Then the officers who were over the units of the army—the commanders of thousands and of hundreds—approached Moses
translations.kjv: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
translations.asv: And the officers that were over the thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses;
